utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’ll keep an ear out while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Much appreciated, Ira. If you hear anything about the repair drive, just let me know and I’ll stick to the plan.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Will do, Eli. I’ll let you know if I hear anything while I’m out.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, I’m in—just send me the repair drive details when you can.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Will do — I’ll send the repair drive details over shortly.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Perfect, thanks — I’ll keep an eye out for it.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, this repair drive is still happening, right?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, I think so — I just want to make sure we’ve got the timing and drop-off details sorted.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great, can you confirm the time and where to drop things off?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive — I meant to bring that box of tools, but I forgot again. If you need help, I can still swing by and lend a hand.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Oren — I could use the help. If you can swing by later, that’d be great.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure thing — I’ll come by later and help however I can.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Before I commit, what kind of repair drive is it, and what details should I check?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: It’s the neighborhood repair drive—just bring any broken small appliances or tools you want checked, and maybe note what’s wrong with each one.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it—I'll bring the broken items and a quick note on what’s wrong with each one. Is there a drop-off time or any limit on how many I can bring?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Jules, sorry I’m late—did I miss anything important about the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: No worries, you didn’t miss much yet — we’re just getting organized and figuring out who can help with what.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Good, I’m happy to help — what do you still need covered?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Sam — could you help sort the donated tools and keep an eye on the table during the drive?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I can sort the donated tools and watch the table during the drive.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m keeping an eye on the repair drive details—when and where are we meeting?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: We’re meeting Saturday morning at the community center parking lot—right after school drop-off for the volunteers with kids.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it — Saturday morning at the community center parking lot, right after school drop-off for the volunteers with kids.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the repair drive? I heard they’re hoping to get a good turnout this weekend—lots of folks pitching in, which is lovely.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’m already telling everyone on the block, and I’ll make sure they know there’s plenty to do this weekend.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So, what still needs fixing for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m still checking the list, but I know a few things need attention. I’ll tell you what I’ve got as soon as I confirm it.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it—just let me know the confirmed list when you have it.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m planning to help with the repair drive and I’ll mention it to the others too.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That’s really kind of you, Vik—thanks for spreading the word. I’d love to help if there’s anything easy I can do too.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely—I'll keep you posted and bring your help up with the others too. Something easy like sorting supplies or handing out flyers would be perfect.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That’s so great of you, Quinn—word travels fast when you’re on it! I’ll keep spreading the news too, so we can really get the block involved.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Rosa. I appreciate you helping get the word out.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Of course, Uli — happy to help. I’ll keep nudging folks, and if you want, I can also help line up a few more volunteers.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is getting a good bit of interest already. I can pass along any details if you want.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That’s good to hear. Please pass along the time and place, and I’ll plan on it.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely — I’ll check the flyer and send you the time and place as soon as I can. If I spot any updates, I’ll pass those along too.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late—how’s the repair drive going?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: No worries — it’s going well. I’ll keep folks posted as the repair drive gets set up.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Great, thanks — I’ll check back in soon and see where I can help.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I heard about the repair drive. What do you need help with?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Rey. Honestly, I could use help sorting the supplies and maybe getting a ride for a few things.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help sort the supplies, and I might be able to give you a ride too. Just tell me when and where.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m heading over to the repair drive now—if you need me, I should be by the community center entrance.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — I’ll swing by if I need you. Thanks, Opal!

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I can help spread the word about the repair drive and connect folks who want to pitch in. What part still needs the most help?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Jules — the biggest need is still hands-on helpers for the repair stations, plus a few people to sort donated tools. Could you share that and ask anyone interested to stop by early?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word and tell folks to stop by early if they can help at the repair stations or sort tools.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — the repair drive. I might’ve missed the details; what’s happening with it?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: We’re collecting broken household items for the repair volunteers this Saturday at the community center, and folks can drop things off between 10 and 2. If you want, I can send you the full details.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: That’d be great — I definitely missed part of that. Could you send me the details?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good—what’s the latest on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: We’ve got a decent start, but I’m still rounding up a few more tools and supplies. If you need anything fixed, bring it by and I’ll take a look.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Gus—I'll keep an eye out for anything that needs fixing. Let me know if you still need any specific tools or supplies.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure, Leo — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to bring or do?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Could you bring your drill and a few screws? I’ll handle the rest at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’ll bring my drill and a few screws to the community center.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m happy to help, but I’d like to know the exact pickup time and what needs to be moved first so we can keep it organized.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: That makes sense — can we set the pickup for 9 a.m., and start with the boxes in the garage first?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, 9 a.m. works for me, and starting with the garage boxes sounds easiest. If you can label anything fragile, I’ll keep an eye on that first.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’m happy to spread the word about the repair drive. If you want, I can invite a few neighbors right away.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: That would be great, Quinn—thank you. A few neighbors right away would really help get the repair drive rolling.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: You got it — I’ll invite a few folks now and let them know it’s starting up. I’ll send you any quick replies I get.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help work around the school schedule, but I need the repair drive details first.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — the repair drive. I’m sorry, I’ve got the details scribbled somewhere; I’ll grab them and bring them to you right away.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Oren — just bring them when you can and I’ll fit it around pickup time.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Nell, I’m getting the repair drive organized and I’d love your help. If you have any houses or issues to add, send them my way and I’ll keep the list updated.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Rosa — I’ll keep an ear out and pass along anything I hear about. I don’t know of any right now, but I’ll check around.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Nell — I really appreciate that. Just let me know whenever you hear anything, and I’ll add it right away.
